industry.note: Bounded gameplay correction to the immutable initial factory stock using local source evidence; not a claim of 1:1 EU5/V3 jobs. Britain is no longer a hard output frontier. No tag-specific bonus, automatic late technology, or unemployment-driven industry target.

cultivated_land_recovery.note: Observed crops/working irrigation plus high local development can represent land already cultivated despite a forest/jungle map label. No modern reclamation assumed. Desert and arctic remain excluded; wetlands and mountains heavily limited. Population cannot raise this ceiling.

notes: Apply the same rule to every mapped source country and province in any save; no special Sumatra or Italy tag list.

Industry additions require local source manufacturing, legal technology/PMs, local workforce/infrastructure, and household balance checks. Extra domestic input gaps are limited to 10% of baseline use per good and 25% of new output base value; these are unfilled import needs, never fabricated trade.
Existing military, public buildings, diplomacy, geographic mineral capacities and commercial farms remain protected.
Extra arable land initially supports subsistence only. Land is measured against original V3 geography, not repeatedly multiplied.
Rebuild both population choices from the original population after changing jobs or land; never compound population cuts.
